zoe_pm: Tiny UX thread: updated routing editor frames. Focus: clarify priority numbering, reduce ambiguous 'rule conflict' copy, and ensure keyboard reordering announces position.
karla_design: New mock uses a persistent numeric badge + subtle hover drag handle. Adding a short helper: 'Priority: lower numbers run first.' and an expanded helper for first-time users.
ivan_fe: Will make badge editable inline with validation: 'Must be a unique integer'. For duplicates show inline hint: 'Conflict with "Charge VAT"  reorder or edit conditions.' Also adding move up/down keyboard actions.
abe_research: From testing: users expect typing numbers. Screen reader note: after a reorder announce 'Rule "X" moved to position 2 of 6.' Use a role=status live region.
ci-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-previews.redwood.sh/1881-priority-clarity
zoe_pm: Karla drop final Figma link and exact ARIA attributes and we'll review Friday. Thanks!
